objs.name: document
objs.description: A managed artifact subject to creation, editing, approval, and archiving in the P&R management system

objs.name: policy
objs.description: A company-wide regulation and process at strategic level

objs.name: guideline
objs.description: A document describing locally defined or business process-specific regulations and instructions

objs.name: work_instruction
objs.description: A document describing specific procedures, process sequences, and responsible persons

objs.name: procedural_instruction
objs.description: A document describing specific procedures within a framework or process sequence

objs.name: additional_information
objs.description: A supplementary document attachment not subject to the release cycle of the main document

objs.name: attachment
objs.description: A controlled document automatically released with the main document and subject to the release cycle

objs.name: change_proposal
objs.description: A proposed amendment to an existing document managed without affecting version history

objs.name: validity_extension_request
objs.description: A system-generated request to check and extend document validity

objs.name: override_request
objs.description: A request to invalidate and archive a document

objs.name: reactivation_request
objs.description: A request to reactivate a previously invalidated document

objs.name: user
objs.description: A person who performs actions within the P&R management system

objs.name: author
objs.description: A user responsible for creating and editing document content

objs.name: co_author
objs.description: A user with additional personal change rights on a document

objs.name: reviewer
objs.description: A user who checks document content for technical and formal aspects

objs.name: releaser
objs.description: A user responsible for approving and releasing documents

objs.name: translator
objs.description: A user who translates released documents to other languages

objs.name: reader
objs.description: A user who views approved documents

objs.name: user_group
objs.description: A collection of users assigned with shared authorizations

objs.name: reader_group
objs.description: A user group with read-only access to documents

objs.name: archive_group
objs.description: A special user group with access to archived documents

objs.name: distribution_list
objs.description: A list of users and user groups assigned to receive document distributions

objs.name: electronic_signature
objs.description: A digital signature applied by workflow participants

objs.name: audit_trail
objs.description: A record of document actions and changes for traceability

objs.name: version
objs.description: A distinct iteration of a document with associated status and validity

objs.name: workflow_task
objs.description: A task assigned to a user within a document approval process

objs.name: document_template
objs.description: A predefined structure used to create new documents of a specific type

objs.name: metadata
objs.description: Descriptive properties and attributes of a document

objs.name: it_application
objs.description: A software system referenced or linked to a document

evts.name: create_document
evts.description: Attach and initialize a new document in the system

evts.name: upload_file
evts.description: Upload an external file or document to a document object

evts.name: convert_document
evts.description: Automatically convert a document to PDF format

evts.name: submit_for_review
evts.description: Initiate the review step of the document approval workflow

evts.name: review_document
evts.description: Check document content for technical and formal aspects

evts.name: approve_document
evts.description: Release and publish a document following approval

evts.name: sign_document
evts.description: Apply an electronic signature to a document during workflow

evts.name: publish_document
evts.description: Make a released document visible to addressed readers

evts.name: revise_document
evts.description: Create a new version of a released document

evts.name: archive_attachment
evts.description: Mark an attachment for archiving due to no longer being relevant

evts.name: create_change_proposal
evts.description: Propose an amendment to an existing document

evts.name: implement_change_proposal
evts.description: Create a new version incorporating a change proposal

evts.name: extend_validity
evts.description: Confirm continued validity of a document and update the valid-until date

evts.name: invalidate_document
evts.description: Declare a document out of force and archive it

evts.name: reactivate_document
evts.description: Re-validate and restore an archived document

evts.name: translate_document
evts.description: Translate released document content to another language

evts.name: confirm_acknowledgement
evts.description: A user actively confirms receipt and understanding of a document

evts.name: send_distribution_notification
evts.description: Notify users via email about a released document
